seoTitle: Create ZIP File Online — Free, No Upload | FileFolks
seoDescription: Compress multiple files into a ZIP archive. Drop your files and download. Runs entirely in your browser.

faqs.question: Are my files uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. ZIP creation uses the JSZip library running entirely in your browser. Your files never leave your device.

faqs.question: How many files can I add?
faqs.answer: There is no hard limit. The practical limit depends on your device memory and the total uncompressed size.

faqs.question: What compression does it use?
faqs.answer: DEFLATE compression at level 6, the same algorithm used by most ZIP tools.

faqs.question: Can I add more files after the initial drop?
faqs.answer: Yes. Drop more files onto the drop zone at any time before clicking Create ZIP.
